next.reason: Same. 1985: the item 'will assume the specified value each time its report group is printed', GROUP INDICATE limiting it to certain object-time conditions. 2023 §2023:13.18.63.4 GR22: 'The value of literal-1 is used for the content of the printable item whenever it is printed', except that GROUP INDICATE may suppress it; §2023:13.18.28.4 GR1 gives the GROUP INDICATE conditions (first GENERATE after INITIATE, page advance, control break) as a PRESENT WHEN, whose false case omits the item (§2023:13.18.41.4 GR2). PRESENT WHEN and OCCURS DEPENDING suppression apply to clauses a 1985 report item cannot carry.
